notes: Prefer list-pool-activations --state <NotStarted|InProgress|Succeeded|Failed|Cancelled|Unknown>; it builds the supported state filter and conflicts with raw --filter. --query applies to one-shot payloads, not activation --follow. Follow emits bounded NDJSON and stops on failure/cancellation as well as success; reason complete is terminal, not successful. Historical Succeeded/resource counts are not current warm-capacity guarantees.
